name: issue-opened
description: A maintainer opens an issue; om-auto-manage-issues adds the SDLC labels, checks the Definition of Ready and comments its analysis (ADR 0017). `authors` is the gate: the run holds Bash with no allowlist and the issue body is its input, so an issue from anyone else is handled from the cockpit by a human. Issues a run holds or a human put on hold never match.

name: pr-opened
description: A maintainer opens a pull request; om-auto-review-pr reviews it and moves the pipeline label, never merges (ADR 0017). Dependabot's PRs carry nothing to review by hand, so `authors` keeps them out. Agent PRs are authored by `design4pro-agent` (the cockpit's `gh` identity) and reviewed inside their own chain, so `authors` keeps them out; `merge-queue` / `changes-requested` stay excluded as the marks of a PR the chain has already reviewed, since the poller re-checks labels on every poll. `in-progress` and `ci-monitoring` are a run still working; `do-not-merge` is a human hold.
